35062-the-woodpeckers.creator: Unknown
35062-the-woodpeckers.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Long ago in Greece, the legend runs, a terrible monster called the Sphinx used to waylay travelers to ask them riddles: whoever could not answer these she killed, but the man who did answer them killed her and made an end of her riddling.

57903-soldiers-and-sailors-or-anecdotes-.creator: Unknown

arxiv-1610-03013.title: Display Advertising with Real-Time Bidding (RTB) and Behavioural Targeting
arxiv-1610-03013.creator: Jun Wang
arxiv-1610-03013.description: Abstract Abstract The most significant progress in recent years in online display advertising is what is known as the Real-Time Bidding (RTB) mechanism to buy and sell ads. RTB essentially facilitates buying an individual ad impression in real time while it is still being generated from a user’s visit.

arxiv-2205-04723.title: Robust Medical Image Classification from Noisy Labeled Data with Global and Local Representation Guided Co-training
arxiv-2205-04723.creator: Cheng Xue, Lequan Yu, Pengfei Chen, Qi Dou, Pheng-Ann Heng
arxiv-2205-04723.description: Abstract Deep neural networks have achieved remarkable success in a wide variety of natural image and medical image computing tasks. However, these achievements indispensably rely on accurately annotated training data. If encountering some noisy-labeled images, the network training procedure would suffer from difficulties, leading to a sub-optimal classifier.

arxiv-2206-07509.title: Mandheling : Mixed-Precision On-Device DNN Training with DSP Offloading Thanks: *Equal contributions; # Corresponding authors.
arxiv-2206-07509.creator: Daliang Xu 1∗ , Mengwei Xu 2∗ # , Qipeng Wang 1 , Shangguang Wang 2 , Yun Ma 1 , Kang Huang 3 , Gang Huang 1 , Xin Jin 1 , Xuanzhe Liu 1#
arxiv-2206-07509.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Daliang Xu 1∗ , Mengwei Xu 2∗ # , Qipeng Wang 1 , Shangguang Wang 2 , Yun Ma 1 , Kang Huang 3 , Gang Huang 1 , Xin Jin 1 , Xuanzhe Liu 1#. This paper proposes Mandheling , the first system that enables highly resource-efficient on-device training by orchestrating the mixed-precision training with on-chip Digital Signal Processing (DSP) offloading.

arxiv-2207-14210.title: On the largest sum-free subset problem in the integers Thanks: The author thanks Ben Green for useful discussions.
arxiv-2207-14210.creator: George Shakan
arxiv-2207-14210.description: Abstract . Let A ⊂ ℤ > 0 A\subset\mathbb{Z}_{>0} of size n n . It is conjectured that for any C > 0 C>0 and n n large enough that A A contains a sum-free subset of size at least n / 3 + C n/3+C .

arxiv-2208-04825.title: Longitudinal Prediction of Postnatal Brain Magnetic Resonance Images via a Metamorphic Generative Adversarial Network Journal: Journal of Pattern Recognition
arxiv-2208-04825.creator: Yunzhi Huang, Sahar Ahmad, Luyi Han, Shuai Wang, Zhengwang Wu, Weili Lin, Gang Li, Li Wang, Pew-Thian Yap
arxiv-2208-04825.description: Abstract Missing scans are inevitable in longitudinal studies due to either subject dropouts or failed scans. In this paper, we propose a deep learning framework to predict missing scans from acquired scans, catering to longitudinal infant studies. Prediction of infant brain MRI is challenging owing to the rapid contrast and structural changes particularly during the first year of life.

arxiv-2208-10262.title: Controls that expedite first passage times in disordered systems
arxiv-2208-10262.creator: Marc Höll, Alon Nissan, Brian Berkowitz, Eli Barkai
arxiv-2208-10262.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Marc Höll, Alon Nissan, Brian Berkowitz, Eli Barkai. First passage time statistics in disordered systems exhibiting scale invariance are studied widely. In particular, long trapping times in energy or entropic traps are fat-tailed distributed, which slow the overall transport process. We study the statistical properties of the first passage time of biased processes in different models, and employ the big jump principle that shows the dominance of the maximum trapping time on the first passage time.

arxiv-2209-02570.title: When Privacy Meets Partial Information: A Refined Analysis of Differentially Private Bandits
arxiv-2209-02570.creator: Achraf Azize, Debabrota Basu
arxiv-2209-02570.description: Abstract We study the problem of multi-armed bandits with ϵ \epsilon -global Differential Privacy (DP). First, we prove the minimax and problem-dependent regret lower bounds for stochastic and linear bandits that quantify the hardness of bandits with ϵ \epsilon -global DP. These bounds suggest the existence of two hardness regimes depending on the privacy budget ϵ \epsilon .

arxiv-2210-05421.title: Modeling photometric variations due to a global inhomogeneity on an obliquely rotating star: application to lightcurves of white dwarfs
arxiv-2210-05421.creator: Yasushi Suto, Shin Sasaki, Masataka Aizawa, Kotaro Fujisawa, and Kazumi Kashiyama
arxiv-2210-05421.description: Abstract We develop a general framework to compute photometric variations induced by the oblique rotation of a star with an axisymmetric inhomogeneous surface. We apply the framework to compute lightcurves of white dwarfs adopting two simple models of their surface inhomogeneity.

arxiv-2301-03608.title: The NANOGrav 12.5-year Data Set: Bayesian Limits on Gravitational Waves from Individual Supermassive Black Hole Binaries Facilities: Arecibo, GBT enterprise ( Ellis et al. 2019 ) , enterprise_extensions ( Taylor et al. 2021 ) , PTMCMCSampler ( Ellis & van Haasteren 2017 ) , hasasia ( Hazboun et al.
arxiv-2301-03608.creator: Zaven Arzoumanian, Paul T. Baker, Laura Blecha, Harsha Blumer, Adam Brazier, Paul R. Brook, Sarah Burke-Spolaor, Bence Bécsy, J. Andrew Casey-Clyde, Maria Charisi, Shami Chatterjee, Siyuan Chen, James M. Cordes, Neil J. Cornish, Fronefield Crawford, H. Thankful Cromartie, Megan E. DeCesar, Paul B. D
arxiv-2301-03608.description: Abstract Pulsar timing array collaborations, such as the North American Nanohertz Observatory for Gravitational Waves (NANOGrav), are seeking to detect nanohertz gravitational waves emitted by supermassive black hole binaries formed in the aftermath of galaxy mergers. We have searched for continuous waves from individual circular supermassive black hole binaries using NANOGrav’s recent 12.5-year data set.

arxiv-2302-14148.title: Scalable precision wide-field imaging in radio interferometry: I. uSARA validated on ASKAP data 2023 Scalable precision wide-field imaging in radio interferometry: I. uSARA validated on ASKAP data – References
arxiv-2302-14148.creator: A. G. Wilber, A. Dabbech, A. Jackson, Y. Wiaux
arxiv-2302-14148.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. G. Wilber, A. Dabbech, A. Jackson, Y. Wiaux. As Part I of a paper series showcasing a new imaging framework, we consider the recently proposed unconstrained Sparsity Averaging Reweighted Analysis (uSARA) optimisation algorithm for wide-field, high-resolution, high-dynamic range, monochromatic intensity imaging. We reconstruct images from real radio-interferometric observations obtained with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) and present these results in comparison to the widely-used, state-of-the-art imager WSClean .

arxiv-2308-05056.title: A Nesterov type algorithm with double Tikhonov regularization: fast convergence of the function values and strong convergence to the minimal norm solution
arxiv-2308-05056.creator: Mikhail Karapetyants, Szilárd Csaba László
arxiv-2308-05056.description: Abstract Abstract. We investigate the strong convergence properties of a Nesterov type algorithm with two Tikhonov regularization terms in connection to the minimization problem of a smooth convex function f. We show that the generated sequences converge strongly to the minimal norm element from \argmin f .

arxiv-2406-13861.title: Skew circuits and circumference in a binary matroid
arxiv-2406-13861.creator: Sean McGuinness
arxiv-2406-13861.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sean McGuinness. The circumference of a matroid is defined to be the size of the largest circuit. For disjoint sets X X and Y Y in a matroid M M having ground set E E we define κ M ​ ( X , Y ) = min X ⊆ A ⊆ E − Y ⁡ r ⁡ ( A ) + r ⁡ ( E − A ) − r ⁡ ( M ) . \kappa_{M}(X,Y)=\min_{X\subseteq A\subseteq E-Y}r(A)+r(E-A)-r(M).

arxiv-2410-06228.title: Investigation of rotational augmentation mechanisms on wind turbine blade sections based on Quasi-3D simulations
arxiv-2410-06228.creator: Pedro Rodrigues, Elmer Gennaro, Daniel Souza *
arxiv-2410-06228.description: Abstract Rotation has been recognized for its ability to decrease the extent of separate flow regions on the inner sections of horizontal-axis wind turbine blades. This alteration is often linked to centrifugal pumping. Nevertheless, studies focused on insect flight conditions revealed a significant contribution of the Coriolis acceleration to the balance of vorticity within the leading-edge vortex (LEV).

arxiv-2501-10743.title: Analysis of Age-Energy Trade-off in IoT Networks Using Stochastic Geometry Thanks: The preliminary version of this paper was presented at the 22nd International Symposium on Modeling and Optimization in Mobile, Ad hoc, and Wireless Networks. WiOpt, RAWNET workshop, 2024 [ 1 ] . Songita Das is with t
arxiv-2501-10743.creator: Songita Das, Graduate Student Member , IEEE and Gourab Ghatak, Member , IEEE
arxiv-2501-10743.description: Abstract We study an internet of things (IoT) network where devices harvest energy from transmitter power. IoT devices use this harvested energy to operate and decode data packets. We propose a slot division scheme based on a parameter ξ \xi , where the first phase is for energy harvesting (EH) and the second phase is for data transmission.

arxiv-2507-00469.title: Bisecle: Binding and Separation in Continual Learning for Video Language Understanding
arxiv-2507-00469.creator: Yue Tan, Xiaoqian Hu, Hao Xue, Celso De Melo, Flora D. Salim
arxiv-2507-00469.description: Abstract Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) have made remarkable improvements in video understanding tasks. However, real-world videos typically exist as continuously evolving data streams (e.g., dynamic scenes captured by wearable glasses), necessitating models to continually adapt to shifting data distributions and novel scenarios.

pmc-11348715.title: The backbone constitution drives passive permeability independent of side chains in depsipeptide and peptide macrocycles inspired by ent-verticilide†
pmc-11348715.creator: Madelaine P. Thorpe, Abigail N. Smith, Daniel J. Blackwell, Corey R. Hopkins, Bjorn C. Knollmann, Wendell S. Akers, Jeffrey N. Johnston
pmc-11348715.description: The number of peptide-like scaffolds found in late-stage drug development is increasing, but a critical unanswered question in the field is whether substituents (side chains) or the backbone drive passive permeability. The backbone is scrutinized in this study. Five series of macrocyclic peptidic compounds were prepared, and their passive permeability was determined (PAMPA, Caco-2), to delineate structure–permeability relationships.

pmc-11429030.title: Relationship between SARS-CoV-2 infection and ICU-acquired candidemia in critically ill medical patients: a multicenter prospective cohort study
pmc-11429030.creator: Florian Reizine, Nicolas Massart, Alexandre Mansour, Yannick Fedun, Anaïs Machut, Charles-Hervé Vacheron, Anne Savey, Arnaud Friggeri, Alain Lepape, the REAREZO study group
pmc-11429030.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundWhile SARS-CoV2 infection has been shown to be a significant risk-factor for several secondary bacterial, viral and Aspergillus infections, its impact on intensive care unit (ICU)-acquired candidemia (ICAC) remains poorly explored.MethodUsing the REA-REZO network (French surveillance network of ICU-acquired infections), we included all adult patients hospitalized for a medical reason of admission in participating ICUs for at least 48 h from January 2020 to January 2023. To account for confounders, a non-parsimonious propensity score matching was performed.

pmc-11438894.title: Chlamydomonas sp. extract meliorates the growth and physiological responses of ‘Camarosa’ strawberry (Fragaria × ananassa Duch) under salinity stress
pmc-11438894.creator: Sahar Jalalian, Asghar Ebrahimzadeh, Seyed Morteza Zahedi, Silvia Jiménez Becker, Faezeh Hayati, Mohammad Bagher Hassanpouraghdam, Farzad Rasouli
pmc-11438894.description: Microalgae like Chlamydomonas are beneficial organisms employed as biological stimulants to improve plants’ growth, fruit quality, and stress tolerance. In the current study, the effects of Chlamydomonas sp. foliar spraying (0, 20, and 40 ml L−1) were assayed on Camarosa strawberry plants under salinity stress (0, 40, and 80 mM NaCl).

pmc-11504274.title: Real-World Experience in the Clinical Use of Pirfenidone in Patients with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis in Taiwan: A Post-Marketing Surveillance Study
pmc-11504274.creator: Ping-Hung Kuo, Chih-Yen Tu, Chia-Hung Chen, Kuo-Chin Kao, Jeng-Yuan Hsu, Meng-Chih Lin, Inn-Wen Chong, Chau-Chyun Sheu
pmc-11504274.description: Background: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a serious, progressive lung disease for which treatments are scarce. Pirfenidone has been approved for the treatment of IPF in Taiwan since 2016. This study aimed to gain a better insight into pirfenidone’s real-world safety and effectiveness in adult IPF patients in Taiwan.

pmc-11614559.title: Assessment of Optical Attenuation and Skin Thickness in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Patients Using Optical Coherence Tomography
pmc-11614559.creator: Minghui Chen, Yue Shen, Jianguo Zhu, Tingwei Su, Yifei Zhang, Weiqing Wang, Chang Chen, Lin Zhou
pmc-11614559.description: Diabetes management often involves invasive blood glucose monitoring, which can be uncomfortable for patients. Non‐invasive techniques like multiple μ‐spatially offset Raman spectroscopy (mμSORS) offer a promising alternative. To provide clinical data supporting mμSORS, we conducted a clinical trial with 198 participants to evaluate mμSORS for non‐invasive blood glucose measurement.

pmc-13194875.title: A preliminary model to establish a digital twin for coffee roasting
pmc-13194875.creator: Manuel Jonathan Bruno, Nadaniela Egidi, Lorella Fatone, Josephin Giacomini, Pierluigi Maponi, Gianni Sagratini, Agnese Santanatoglia, Edin Trebović
pmc-13194875.description: The coffee industry has an economic impact of over 100 billion dollars per year, making it one of the most valuable markets in the world. Coffee roasting is a crucial step that occurs before the extraction process and is essential to the final quality of the coffee.

pmc-13240916.title: Explainable IAOA-CNN-CBAM-SVR model for predicting air consumption of auxiliary nozzles with limited sample size
pmc-13240916.creator: Min Shen, Yongbo Cao, Xiaoshuang Xiong, Zhen Wang, Lianqing Yu, Xuezheng Yang, Yongfa Lv
pmc-13240916.description: Air-jet looms are energy-intensive machines, with auxiliary nozzles accounting for nearly 80% of the total compressed air consumption. However, accurate prediction and visual analysis of nonlinear air consumption remain challenging due to limited training data and the poor interpretability of deep learning models.

pmc-13360720.creator: Reynaldo Arellano-Cervantes, Raymundo Escutia-Gutiérrez, Nancy Evelyn Navarro-Ruiz, Erika Fabiola López-Villalobos, María Luisa Muñoz-Almaguer, Karime Lilian Franco-Pérez, Diana Esperanza Arévalo-Simental, Aline Priscilla Santiago-García, J Ahuixotl Gutiérrez-Aceves, Delia Flores-Avila, Tammy Marah Estrella Vergara-de la Torre, Santiago José Guevara-Martínez, Cesar Ricardo Cortéz-Álvarez, Felipe Alexis Avalos-Salgado

pmc-13415769.title: Unveiling the potential geographic range of Lepidium meyenii (Maca) and its climate-driven shifts in a changing climate
pmc-13415769.creator: Zeyu Qin, Huasheng Huang, Xuanqi Liu, Xia Meng, Minqiao Li
pmc-13415769.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Global warming has induced pronounced phenological shifts and community degradation in alpine herbaceous plants. However, their spatiotemporal distributions, future responses to climate change, and the underlying environmental drivers remain poorly understood. Here, we focus on Lepidium meyenii, a medicinal herb native to the high-altitude regions of the Andes Mountains in South America, which may face habitat contraction and potential population decline in the future due to changing environments.

pmc-13538679.title: Solvation-engineering-enabled quasi-solid positive electrode for four-electron aqueous Zn||Br batteries
pmc-13538679.creator: Zejun Chen, Mengzi Geng, Shizhen Li, Hangqi Yang, Wanru Chen, Ning Li, Xianbo Jin, Chuang Peng
pmc-13538679.description: Diffusion, crossover, and hydrolysis of bromine species in aqueous electrolytes impede the application of Zn||Br batteries with four-electron 2Br+/Br2/2Br− conversion. Here, we study a ligand-assisted sparingly solvating electrolyte using ZnSO4·7H2O and urea. The high solubility of urea suppresses water activity, while its stronger affinity toward bromine enables preferential coordination over water molecules.
